pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal regions with high-frequency, jagged edge gradients. Patches exhibit sharp angularity and varying spatial areas, with many displaying stellate or star-shaped protrusions into the negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with frequent multi-node junctions. Pixel thickness of corridors is narrow and relatively uniform, creating a high-contrast lattice against the darker patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the upper neck shows a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated contour against the background. The silhouette is short and appears stiff.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark avian organisms (oxpeckers) perched on the upper neck and mid-neck regions, and one in flight in the background.
